selected_mechanism: cyclic-rule-margin formation coupled to endogenous AdamW slingshot reservoir dynamics
prefix_inputs: validation token inputs and validation logits at observed evaluations
materialized parameter and Adam first/second-moment states

fixed_structural_law.rule_coordinate_equation: coordinate(target) = coordinate(left) + coordinate(right) modulo operand vocabulary size
fixed_structural_law.burst_detection: contiguous total_norm > 1 regions whose peak exceeds 5
fixed_structural_law.formation_rule: positive prefix rule-probability velocity plus the next state-predicted slingshot/recovery cycle

prefix_inferred_state: last and next slingshot burst state

operative_state_fields.rule_probability and rule_probability_ve: advance the predicted rule state and validation curve and are required for will_transition
operative_state_fields.next_burst_step and cycle_interval_estim: set the transition timing blend, projected instability intervals and slingshot phase

uncertainty: Within-run prefix replay supports the state law; one discovery execution cannot prove cross-run invariance, so both sealed transition intervals and transient-risk intervals remain prospective claims.
